d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Jamaica vs Côte d'Ivoire in Group E of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Côte d'Ivoire claimed a 3-1 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Abdoul Doumbia opened the scoring and Koudougnon Drebo struck twice before half-time, with Jamone Lyle pulling one back for Jamaica after the break. Côte d'Ivoire finish second in Group E to reach the Round of 32, while Jamaica exit the tournament.
